episodes.description:
Disclaimer: This podcast discusses sensitive topics including science, religion, mantras, superstition, godmen, history, caste, and other controversial subjects.

The views expressed by the speakers are their own and do not necessarily reflect the views of this channel or its team. This content is intended for discussion and informational purposes only and is not meant to hurt or disrespect any individual, community, religion, caste, or belief.

Viewer discretion is advised.

🧠 New Episode Alert: The Evolution of God, Religion, Science & Human Civilization | YINT TALKS Telugu Podcast.How did the idea of God begin? When were religions formed? Did science and spirituality always stand on opposite sides? In this thought-provoking episode of YINT TALKS, we explore the origins of human civilization,
the birth of religions and cultures, the evolution of intelligence, ancient India, forgotten scientificachievements, tribal history, literature, and the relationship between faith and science.The conversation also examines cults, self-proclaimed godmen, black magic claims, religiousexploitation, crimes committed in the name of faith, and how scientific thinking transformed human civilization. Whether you're interested in history, philosophy, religion, archaeology, science, or human evolution, this episode invites you to think critically and explore different perspectives.
